cohort: Pregnant women scheduled for primary emergency or elective cesarean section
finding: The MML method for cesarean section resulted in shorter operating and extraction times, lower limitations in movement 24 hours post-operation, and reduced analgesic requirements compared to the PK method.
mod_finding: The study found that the modified Misgav-Ladach method (MML) for cesarean section resulted in shorter operating and extraction times compared to the Pfannenstiel-Kerr method.
